pages.text: Rift Shards are the endgame currency. Farm them from Oblivion's Rift runs and Tier 4 boss kills to fund the $(bold)Mythic Gear Chase$(), the character improvement loop that comes after Tier 4.$(br2)$(bold)Rift Keystone$(): 5 Rift Shards plus a boss material. You need one to open an Oblivion's Rift portal.

$(bold)Mythic Infusion$()$(br2)Mythic infusion raises a Legendary item to Mythic tier (Mythic I to V). Each Mythic level:$(br)$(li)raises every existing affix value by ~15%$(li)adds one more socket$(li)unlocks a visual effect on the item
Mythic V is the ceiling. Reaching it takes deep Rift farming: it is the long-term endgame loop, by design.$(br2)$(bold)Next: craft a Rift Keystone and run your first Rift.$()
